_comment: Single source of truth for Frame Restoration Utah's external identity. The audit-cta-integrity gate asserts that every customer-facing surface matches THESE values. Change identity here, not scattered across HTML. See scripts/audit-cta-integrity.mjs.

gbp._comment: Canonical Google Business Profile. cid + data_id verified 2026-06-01 against live Google Maps (h1 'Frame Restoration Utah', Heber City 40.5058,-111.4143). This is the 5-star profile the site scrapes via scripts/update-google-reviews.py.

entity_links._comment: Canonical off-site identity replicated onto EVERY location page for entity consistency (AEO Pillar 2): hasMap = GBP map URL; sameAs = the same profile set as the homepage. AI engines only resolve citations to ONE business when NAP + these links agree across the site AND the third-party directories (third-party-targets.md). audit-entity-consistency.mjs asserts all location pages carry exactly these. DOPL license (#14256097-5501) is intentionally NOT here — it is hasCredential, not a sameAs URL. Expanded 2026-06-10 with the 5 claimed public directory profiles from the consensus pipeline (gohebervalley/angi/homeadvisor/thumbtack/nextdoor); Bing Places intentionally excluded until public (non-dashboard) listing URLs exist. Reconciled 2026-07-07 with BuildZoom + Birdeye + Apple Maps, which PR #144 (6/30 trust sweep) added to index.html + all location pages but never added here — the keystone had drifted from the live pages, failing this gate on every run since 6/30.

location_overrides._comment: Per-location GBP identity: a page with its own verified profile can override hasMap and sameAs. Every unlisted page keeps the Heber keystone. The SLC override was corrected 2026-08-11 from a staged office/DID assumption to the live service-area profile verified under ryan@framerestorations.com.

_review_form_link_note: Direct one-tap write-review deep link for the canonical GBP (place_id resolved via SerpAPI 2026-06-01, no owner login needed). Opens the star-rating dialog. Equivalent to the official g.page/r/ 'Ask for reviews' link. review.html's Google button uses this.
_internal_phone_note: LANDON_PHONE — call-forward target behind the tracking number. MUST appear in zero published HTML. The gate blocks any published page that contains it in any format (tel:, dashed, dotted, parenthesized, +1).
_known_wrong_listing_note: cid 16833... resolved to an empty Salt Lake-valley coordinate (no business) — the dead listing review.html mistakenly pointed at. Listed so the gate hard-blocks it ever reappearing in a published page.
